Name: Friendly magical vegan truffle Bears (pig replacement)
Author: DorakoKentaurosu
Description:
[size=6]HEY, YOU![/size][size=5] [/size][size=1]How's your day been?[/size]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Have you always loathed over the fact that pigs are [s]disgusting[/s] a little boring in their design? well [b]loath no more[/b] as the Friendly magical vegan truffle bear is now [i]available[/i] to the world.

Based on the sprite of the not so friendly grizzly bears seen elsewhere throughout Stardew Valley, the friendly magical vegan truffle bear come from the great white north itself to live in your humble barn.

 Friendly magical vegan truffle bears have been specially trained to hunt [s]and kill[/s] gourmet truffles scattered throughout the land and magically teleport them right where they stand (for your convenience). [/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Friendly magical vegan truffle bears have also been carefully trained to only eat grass and hay, ensuring that all your barn yard animals will be [i]safe.[/i] So what are you waiting for? Order your Friendly magical vegan truffle bears
[/size][b][size=3]TODAY![/size]
[/b]
[/font][b][size=1]NOTE:[/size][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=1] Friendly magical vegan truffle bears [i]may[/i] not be vegan, and have been know to "replace" baby pigs, if this happens then [s]be thankful[/s] call the local animal control unit. do not expose your Friendly magical vegan truffle bears to direct [u]moonlight[/u] as their obligated to fight evil in it, leaving you wanting to win love in the daylight.  Friendly magical vegan truffle bears have been know to "oink", if you Friendly magical vegan truffle bears are "oinking" then you are eligible for a full refund. visit Canada to learn more.
[/size]
[/font]
